description: sets this episode's cover. image is base64 JPEG or PNG, at most 1 MiB decoded. It must be a square between 1400 and 3000 px, and the bytes must match contentType, or the call is rejected. Send a 1400 × 1400 px square, RGB with no transparency; resize a smaller one up first. Free. An episode with no cover keeps the show cover, or the episode default when the show has none.
name: set_episode_cover
title: Set episode cover
